messages:
ravi_csops: Noticed an abnormal spike in 'renewal_risk_escalate' playbook runs overnight. ~80 runs where health_score dropped >0.25 in <2h and some accounts are mid-onboarding.
alana_data: Looking now. There's a deploy of healthscore-service v4.3 at 02:07 UTC that introduced a new decay factor on usage signals. The rollout toggled `decay_alpha=0.7` by default.
maria_onboard: We should never escalate customers mid-onboarding. Playbook trigger has `a.lifecycle_state = 'active'` but onboarding states are stored in `onboard_state` separate column; mismatch probably caused it.
alerts-bot: deploybot: service=healthscore-service version=v4.3 deployed by ci at 2026-05-10T02:07:12Z\aravi_csops: Sample acct ids: acct-R9, acct-T2. Escalation log: ```[2026-05-10T03:18:05Z] playbook.run renewal_risk_escalate run_id=rr_451 account=acct-R9 trigger=healthscore_delta```. Looks like playbook used new score without checking onboarding.
alana_data: Quick mitigation: revert decay_alpha to previous value and patch scorer flags. I'll flip canary to decay_alpha=0.45 and re-evaluate. Also adding a CI assertion to healthscore rollout: `ensure no onboarding_state in triggered_accounts` for 1000-sample.
maria_onboard: Meanwhile can we pause the playbook? `/playbook pause renewal_risk_escalate --reason "hotfix: onboarding guard"`
alerts-bot: command acknowledged: renewal_risk_escalate paused by ravi_csops at 2026-05-10T03:35:20Z reason=hotfix: onboarding guard\arana_csops: Also create a quick dedupe to avoid duplicate escalations for accounts that already have an open renewal ticket: `SELECT pr.account FROM playbook_runs pr JOIN tickets t ON t.account=pr.account WHERE t.status IN ('open','pending') AND pr.created_at>now()-interval '48 hours';`
alana_data: Revert applied to canary. Running smoke against pb-canary-02. Early signal: delta spikes reduced by 90% in sample. Will plan a full rollback if stable.
maria_onboard: After pause and revert, export the list of affected accounts and mark any customer-facing outreach paused. If any email sent, we'll run the apology template.\aravi_csops: Opening incident CSOPS-12011 and assigning: alang-data (rollback + test), maria_onboard (customer export + outreach), me (postmortem + CI guard). ETA mitigation: 40m.\amalana_data: Putting a long-term fix on the board: 1) unify lifecycle vs onboard_state usage in triggers, 2) add playbook preflight that samples risky runs, 3) require feature-flag gating for decay changes.\aravi_csops: Thanks team. Keep me posted and ping cs-leads once we have final list. :thumbsup:
